title: HHHusher button (v2)
description: Small, square-shouldered buttons in bold monospaced caps with 5px corners: a signal-yellow buy button that empties to a yellow outline on hover, cream-glass buttons for dark backdrops, an outlined button, and a plain 'discover more →' text link that dims on hover.
notes: glass and outline are foreground-coloured: put them on dark bands (the dark class) for the original look
hover timing is the original's: 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.94, 0.6, 1)
name: hhhusher-v2-button

props.name: href
props.description: renders a link when set, a button otherwise

props.name: variant
props.description:
primary: yellow, empties to a yellow outline on hover · glass: cream at 15% (for dark
backdrops), outlined on hover · soft: cream at 20%, a little brighter on hover (the play
button) · outline: 2px foreground border · link: bare caps text with an arrow, dims on hover

props.name: size
props.description: md: 43px tall (the original's buy buttons) · sm: 36px · icon: a 43px square

props.name: arrow
props.description: for the link variant: the arrow after the label (default on)

props.name: label
props.description: for an icon-only button: what a screen reader says
